name: Hex
summary: Curse: +1d6 necrotic on your hits; disadvantage on one ability checks.
description: Bonus action curse. Your attacks deal +1d6 necrotic. Target has disadvantage on checks with one chosen ability. If target drops to 0, reassign hex with bonus action.
higherLevels: Duration up to 8 hours (3rd+) or 24 hours (5th+).
